title: Every Door, Every Role
summary: Build a role-method-path authorization matrix and verify deny-by-default enforcement.
description: ApertureOps hid admin controls in its interface but needs proof that every server route enforces policy.

services.name: role-api
services.purpose: Synthetic role, method, and alternate-path policy service

objectives.title: Build the authorization matrix
objectives.label: Test every role across methods and route aliases

learningOutcomes: Translate role requirements into a method-and-path authorization matrix
Test alternate routes and unlisted operations rather than trusting UI visibility
Verify centralized server-side deny-by-default policy with positive and negative cases
